subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept optional top-level `res.meta` on existing Gateway protocol v4 response frames, after this branch is rebased, despite older strict validators possibly rejecting the new field?
rationale: The patch is the narrow fix for the dropped metadata bug, but adding an emitted top-level response-envelope field is a compatibility posture that code review cannot decide without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after rebase
options.body: Treat optional response metadata as an allowed additive v4 envelope field and land the narrow fix once conflicts and normal checks are resolved.

options.title: Require a version or capability gate
options.body: Ask the author to gate `res.meta` behind protocol negotiation or a client capability so strict older clients never receive the new field unexpectedly.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Defer or close this branch if maintainers do not want top-level response-envelope additions in protocol v4.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after rebase
recommendation.body: Treat optional response metadata as an allowed additive v4 envelope field and land the narrow fix once conflicts and normal checks are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current routing candidate from recent Gateway/protocol blame and PR history on these files.
